notes: Own site (bluebottlecoffee.com) confirms this exact address (3725 Paseo Pl, One Paseo) as a real Blue Bottle cafe but its /menu path 404s and the site is a heavy SPA with no priced menu reachable via curl. DoorDash marketplace page (doordash.com/store/..., server-side schema.org Menu/MenuItem JSON-LD, not the order.online white-label) yielded 54 priced dishes across 16 sections: Beans, Chocolate Beverages, Composed Food, Drip Beverages, Espresso + Drip Beverages, Espresso Beverages, Fizz, Grab & Go Food, Iced Beverages, Iced Espresso Beverages, Milk, Pastry Food, RTD, Specialty Beverages, Tea Lattes, Treats. Dropped a duplicate Most Ordered section (all items repeated elsewhere) and one item with no price (Cutlery). Markup test: prices are almost entirely whole-dollar or .50-ending (national Blue Bottle convention), which defeats the 1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25 divisor test by construction per FINDINGS (round-dollar prices always look clean); no other independent priced source could be found (joe.coffee lists the location with no prices; restaurantguru page rendered no visible prices via curl) so this is single-source at medium confidence.

dishes.name: Espresso Beans
dishes.description: Espresso is neither a type of bean nor a roast, but a miraculous brewing method that creates a deeply concentrated coffee. Our Hayes Valley blend is our favorite for espresso—it makes a deep, dark, Italian-style shot with a voluptuous tawny crema and a somewhat dangerous-looking viscosity.

We choose tender tea leaves from Rishoueun’s first harvest of tencha, or shade-grown matcha plants, and stone-grind them to protect against heat degradation.
